Lead possible Curse Tablet. A rectangle cut from cast lead sheet of thickness 1.7mm, neatly and tightly rolled thrice, leaving a central aperture. The distinction between a curse tablet and a fishing net sinker of Early Medieval form resides in the careful cutting and rolling of the former, which contrasts with the casual rolling or clenching of a weight of similar construction.
